nodes.label: Net Sales Area = Gross - Chiller - Cashier - Column
nodes.norm_label: net sales area = gross - chiller - cashier - column
nodes.rationale: AC uses net effectiveArea to avoid oversizing (chillers self-cool); open question whether gross area better captures air volume. Lamps use net area plus separate cashier zoning (500 lux) since chiller canopies have own lighting and columns need no light.

nodes.label: Fill-Null-Only Update Strategy (Option A)
nodes.rationale: New stores inserted with coordinates; existing stores only get lat/lng filled where null, never reset other fields or audit history.

nodes.label: CRON_SECRET Bearer Auth with Exact-Path Proxy Bypass
nodes.norm_label: cron_secret bearer auth with exact-path proxy bypass
nodes.rationale: Only the exact /api/cron/sync-stores path bypasses Better Auth; the /api/cron prefix is not exempted so future cron routes are not silently public.

nodes.label: Insert-Only Idempotent Store Sync
nodes.rationale: Never update/delete existing stores; createMany skipDuplicates plus unique code constraint make overlapping runs safe without a lock. Any invalid row fails the whole job before DB writes.

nodes.label: AC Load Interpolation Model (Soon 2027)
nodes.rationale: Target BTU = 600 + (T-27)*18.625, clamped to [450,900] BTU/m2. Proportional to weather but requires micro-climate telemetry; R&D roadmap.

nodes.label: AC Calc v1.1.0 Strict Minimum Range (Excel 2023)
nodes.norm_label: ac calc v1.1.0 strict minimum range (excel 2023)
nodes.rationale: Historical baseline from 'Kalkulator AC new 2023 ver 2.xlsx'; forces round-up if density falls below cluster minimum. Guarantees cooling but wastes CAPEX/electricity at critical areas.

nodes.label: AC Calc v1.2.0 Closest Deviation per Temperature Cluster (2026 Standard)
nodes.norm_label: ac calc v1.2.0 closest deviation per temperature cluster (2026 standard)
nodes.rationale: Official 2026 standard: compare floor vs ceil unit counts and pick the one whose actual BTU/m2 density is closest to the cluster target. Validated: 358 of 363 renovated stores (98.6%) matched field ratios; 5 saved one unit. Avoids artificial asymmetric rounding for audit objectivity.

nodes.label: AC Calc v1.2-adj Asymmetric Cluster Rounding
nodes.norm_label: ac calc v1.2-adj asymmetric cluster rounding
nodes.rationale: Experimental: cluster A rounds up (cool reserve), B closest deviation, C rounds down (contain CAPEX). Archived as research comparison.

nodes.norm_label: ac restricted zones (glass/door, open chiller, cashier)
nodes.rationale: No bracket structure and high heat radiation at glass; above chillers blocks service access, risks condensate drips and disrupts air curtain; cashier wall cluttered by backwall/menu boards and staff draft discomfort.

nodes.label: Thermal Potential Gradient with Additive Superposition
nodes.community_name: AC Restricted Zones (Glass/Door, Open Chiller, Cashier)
nodes.norm_label: thermal potential gradient with additive superposition
nodes.rationale: Wide-mouth directional plume (70 deg) from full louver width; overlapping AC intensities sum and clamp at 1.0 to reflect additive cooling.

nodes.label: Thermal Load vs Physical Layout Unit Reconciliation
nodes.community_name: AC Restricted Zones (Glass/Door, Open Chiller, Cashier)
nodes.norm_label: thermal load vs physical layout unit reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Load may say 5 but layout needs 4 (area cut by chiller, compact room >=90% coverage) or vice versa (L-shaped rooms, corridors beyond 7.5m throw). Dual evaluation panel shows BTU target vs coverage % with smart insights to justify CAPEX/OPEX.

nodes.label: Lexicographic Deviation Priority (W/m2 > JS > JB)
nodes.rationale: Adding JB lower bound 1.6m could darken small stores; ordering priorities (power ratio first, side distance second, row spacing last) keeps stores bright while preventing overly dense rows.

nodes.rationale: shadcn components have calibrated spacing; manual spacing breaks visual consistency. Custom components only when shadcn lacks an equivalent, and must be reusable.

nodes.label: Smart Merge Component Update Workflow
nodes.rationale: Use --dry-run and --diff to preserve local modifications; never --overwrite without explicit approval; never fetch raw files from GitHub.
